responsibility: Implements non-template parser support utilities for gccrs that are shared around the main parser class rather than instantiated per token source. In this file those utilities cover module path extraction from `#[path]`/`#![path]` attributes for inline and external module loading, plus macro matcher follow-set validation logic used when parsing `macro_rules!` matchers, including diagnostics for illegal fragment/token sequencing according to Rust’s macro parsing restrictions.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file is not the main parser class declaration; it supplies the non-template out-of-line helpers that back parsing, specifically module `#[path]` extraction and macro matcher follow-set checking/diagnostics. The header is the large template parser interface and type declaration surface, with implementations otherwise coming from `rust-parse-impl.h`.
